Lead, Digital Designer (Apparel & Footwear) - Quick-to-Market

Lead, Digital Designer (Apparel & Footwear) - Quick-to-Market

Values & Innovation

At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values - Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality - serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate.

 

Our Values define and unite us, the beliefs that are the red thread that connects everyone at Under Armour. Our values are rallying cries, reminding us why we're here, and fueling everything we do.

 

Our pursuit of better begins with innovation and with our team's mission of being the best. With us, you get the freedom to go further - no matter your role. That means developing, delivering, and selling the state-of-the-art products and digital tools that make top performers even better.

 

If you are a current Under Armour teammate, apply to this position on the Internal Career Site Here. 

Purpose of Role

Lead the execution and advancement of Digital Apparel Design, driving best-in-class 3D design, digital visualization, and virtual product development across the team. As a key member of the Design team, you will help establish and elevate standards for digital apparel design, rendering quality, and digital asset creation while fostering a collaborative, cross-functional digital ecosystem.

Partner closely with Design and Product Line Management to create high-quality digital products designs that accelerate decision-making, improve speed to market, and reduce physical sampling. Champion the use of digital assets throughout the product creation lifecycle, unlocking efficiencies through streamlined workflows, automation, and repeatable processes

Your Impact

  • Support, develop, and continuously elevate Digital Apparel Design standards, processes, and deliverables to ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across the product creation ecosystem.
  • Lead and execute day-to-day 3D apparel design activities, delivering high-quality digital designs, visualizations, and product representations that support key business milestones and timelines.
  • Serve as a Digital Apparel Design representative in design reviews, apparel huddles, fit sessions, and cross-functional meetings, partnering closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and informed decision-making.
  • Champion advancements in digital product creation by driving innovation in virtual sampling, rendering quality, visualization accuracy, and data-driven design standards that improve efficiency and reduce physical prototyping.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for digital apparel creation tools and workflows, providing training, mentorship, and ongoing support to design teams while staying at the forefront of emerging technologies, software enhancements, and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • Software proficiency and in depth understanding.  Browzwear, Clo, Rhino 3D, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Substance, Keyshot
  • Apparel knowledge and experience participating in the apparel design process.
  • Creative mindset and high visualization standards.
  • 3D Rendering, understanding of Digital materials, drape physics and lighting.
  • Ability to demonstrate a fully digital product creation workflow
  • Bachelors in related field or comparable experience. Industrial Design, Apparel/Fashion Design, Materials, Engineering, etc. 
  • Bachelor's degree with typically 8 years of relevant experience, Master's degree with typically 6 years of relevant experience

Workplace Location

  • Location: This individual must reside within commuting distance from our Baltimore, MD office.
  • Work Schedule: This role follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring 4 days in-office per week. 

Sponsorship Eligibility: (US ONLY) UA does not offer sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based work authorization for this position at this time.

Relocation

  • Relocation may be provided up to a specified amount

 

Base Compensation

$90,000.00-$120,000.00 USD

Most new hires fall within this range and have the opportunity to earn more over time. Initial placement within the salary range, however, is based on an individual's relevant knowledge, skills and experience for the position. UA is committed to helping our teammates succeed and advance in their careers. Base salary is only one component of our competitive Total Rewards package.

Benefits & Perks

 

  • Paid "UA Give Back" Volunteer Days: Work alongside your team to support initiatives in your local community
  • Under Armour Merchandise Discounts
  • Competitive 401(k) plan matching
  • Maternity and Parental Leave for eligible and FMLA-eligible teammates
  • Health & fitness benefits, discounts and resources- We offer teammates across the country programs to promote physical activity and overall well-being

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Under Armour, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, family or paternal status and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Under Armour seeks to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people representing a wide variety of backgrounds and perspectives. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Human Resources team via candidateaccommodations@underarmour.com.

items.Title: Multimedia Graphic Designer
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Sinclair, Inc. is expanding its portfolio of audience-first digital brands, original social programming, and podcasts. We’re seeking a Multimedia Graphic Designer to work closely with the Associate Creative Director and Editorial Teams to create compelling creative for Sinclair’s growing collection of brands and shows that help our growing portfolio connect with audiences across every platform.

We’re looking for someone with strong graphic design skills and experience editing video for digital and social platforms. This role is primarily focused on creating high-quality visual design while providing support for video editing, motion graphics, and multimedia projects as production needs evolve.

The majority of your work will focus on brand execution, campaign development, presentations, marketing collateral, and digital design, with opportunities to edit promotional content, create social videos, and update existing motion graphics when production demands require additional support.

The ideal candidate has exceptional typography, layout, composition, and branding skills, paired with a solid understanding of video editing, pacing, storytelling, and platform-specific creative. You don’t need to be a senior editor or motion designer, but you should be comfortable independently producing polished short-form video content and modifying existing motion graphics projects.

If you’re passionate about brand design, visual storytelling, and creating engaging content across both static and motion mediums, we’d love to see your work.

**Please include a portfolio showcasing both graphic design and video work.**

What You’ll Do

Graphic Design

  • Design presentations, sales materials, social graphics, thumbnails, branded templates, promotional materials, and creative assets across Sinclair’s portfolio.
  • Adapt approved creative concepts into multiple formats, sizes, and platform-specific deliverables.
  • Create and update social templates, digital banners, promotional graphics, and recurring marketing assets.
  • Support the development and maintenance of brand identities, style guides, templates, and creative toolkits.
  • Maintain organized design files, asset libraries, and production-ready creative packages.
  • Review deliverables for quality, consistency, and brand compliance before final delivery.

 

Video & Motion

  • Edit short-form and promotional video content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other digital platforms.
  • Assemble show promos, marketing sizzles, branded content, social cutdowns, talent reels, and internal presentation videos.
  • Update existing After Effects projects, including titles, lower thirds, transitions, and animated graphic packages.
  • Create simple motion graphics and animations that enhance promotional and social content.

 

Collaboration & Workflow

  • Work closely with designers, producers, editors, marketing, sales, and social teams to deliver compelling creative.
  • Handle revisions, alternate versions, and production updates across multiple simultaneous projects.
  • Use AI and emerging creative technologies to streamline repetitive production tasks, versioning, and creative workflows.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas throughout the design process.
  • Manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Who You Are

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in graphic design, multimedia design, or a related creative role.
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional typography, layout, branding, and digital design skills, with examples of video editing and motion graphics.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and InDesign.
  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, color, branding, and visual hierarchy.
  • Experience creating polished presentations in PowerPoint, Google Slides, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to independently edit professional-quality short-form video for digital and social media.
  • Working knowledge of After Effects and the ability to update existing motion graphics templates.
  • Experience adapting creative across multiple platforms while maintaining strong brand consistency.
  • Excellent organizational skills and experience maintaining clean project files, asset libraries, and production workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering polished, accurate creative.
  • Comfortable balancing creative problem-solving with high-volume production work.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to receive feedback and collaborate effectively.
  • Interest in AI-assisted creative workflows and emerging production technologies.
  • Experience working in media, entertainment, sports, podcasts, or digital-first brands is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Figma, Canva, Frame.io, or similar collaboration tools is a plus.
  • Experience with audio editing, color correction, captions, or podcast production is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work occasional nights or weekends during major productions, launches, or live events may be required.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Content Designer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As a Senior Content Designer, you like being at the intersection of content and design. You understand that content that's well designed is easy to follow and understandable. As a champion for our users, you organize and present content in a meaningful way.


You will draw upon your knowledge of content, design and UX best practices, brand guidelines, accessibility standards and competitive research to simplify the user experience. You will collaborate with designers, researchers, product managers, engineering and other stakeholders with occasional direct support from your manager. You may also be called upon to mentor junior colleagues. When you have to show your work, you’ll love the chance to participate and run workshops and design crits.



Experience:

  • 5+ years experience in UX writing , UX Design or Content Design 
  • 2+ years experience with Agile and lean UX/software development practices, including using product management software (Rally, Jira) 
  • 2+ years experience in web and app experiences 
  • 2+ years experience collaborating with internal team members, such as experience designers, accessibility experts  and product managers
  • 2+ years experience in UX wire framing, UX flows, and shaping content for multi-disciplinary projects with prototyping software such as Figma and Miro
  • Experience in health care, pharmacy or other regulated fields (insurance, finance, etc.) 
  • Experience with translation and transcreation best practices 
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise content management systems such as Adobe Experience Manager, Contentful, or similar 
  • Portfolio should include work on digital products and/or services, service design or human centered designs 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with design software (Figma, Airtable, InVision, Miro)
  • Experience with AI tools (Claude-Code, Claude integration with MCPs, FigmaMake, etc.)
  • Experience collaborating across disciplines (design, design ops, research and usability, accessibility, product managers and engineering)  
  • Experience in working with and improving business requirements 
  • Comfortable with UX and Usability terminology, taxonomies and practices, including Design Thinking and Human-Centered Design methods, to solve problems and innovate 
  • Knows how and when to use inventories and audits, content frameworks, competitive analysis and mapping
  • Knows when to collaborate and compromise and when to be the voice for the user and stand up for what’s right. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate complex concepts and processes into compelling, easy-to-follow design with exceptional content. 
  • Conduct UX research and champion data science to understand user behaviors and uncover new opportunities to reach customers with appropriate content and reduce friction. 
  • Create content and design ecosystems for multiple channels, devices and touch points across user journey flows, meeting user needs and adhering to enterprise standards.
  • Challenge the status quo and know when to advocate for new design patterns versus relying on old systems.
  • Drive collaboration with designers, product managers, and diverse business stakeholders to inform requirements to think beyond the product lifecycle and optimize content and user journey.  
  • Lead other content strategists/designers in developing user stories and providing guidance on priorities.
  • Facilitate workshops and design crits and own content reviews and iterations across stakeholders from product to legal.

Education


  • Bachelor or master's degree preferred in the field of Human Computer Interaction, Information Architecture, Technical Writing, English, or Journalism.  Extensive work experience, academic work or certifications in user experience fields are also welcome. 

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$54,300.00 - $145,860.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.  The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.  This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.
